user.title: Connect Obedience
user.description: Open [Obedience authorization]({auth_url}) and approve access. Obedience will then return the connection credentials to Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Reauthorize Obedience
reconfigure.description: Open [Obedience authorization]({auth_url}) and approve access. This creates a completely fresh Obedience extension authorization and replaces the existing credentials.

abort.already_configured: This Obedience connection is already configured.
abort.no_external_url: Home Assistant must have an HTTPS external URL configured before Obedience can be connected.
abort.auth_failed: Obedience authorization did not return valid credentials.

webhook_registration_failed.title: Obedience webhook not registered
webhook_registration_failed.description: Home Assistant could not register the Obedience webhook for {entry}. Real-time updates may be delayed until the next scheduled refresh. Check your HTTPS external URL and network connectivity, then reload the integration.

no_external_url.title: Obedience has no HTTPS external URL
no_external_url.description: No HTTPS external URL is configured for {entry}, so the Obedience webhook could not be registered. Configure an HTTPS external URL in Home Assistant and reload the integration.

increment_habit.name: Increment habit
increment_habit.description: Increment or decrement an Obedience habit's amount.

habit_id.name: Habit ID
habit_id.description: The Obedience habit ID to change.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Non-zero integer amount to change the habit by.
